prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. He holds a black smartphone.

summary:
[reference generation] In the nearly empty office at dusk, <Subject 1> glances at work notifications on his phone, locks it and puts it in his pocket, while his inner voice speaks off-screen.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlight roll-off and restrained contrast, in cool blue-gray evening tones.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up as he sits at his desk in the nearly empty open-plan office at dusk, turned three-quarters toward the camera, his face sharp and evenly lit. He wears his plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under the unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt. The closed silver laptop and a white coffee cup sit at the lower edge of the frame. Behind him, out of focus, empty desks and the floor-to-ceiling windows show a dark-blue skyline with scattered lit windows. He picks up a black smartphone from the desk with his right hand and raises it to chest height, looking down at the screen. The screen glows with a few soft, blurred notification shapes in gray and white, with no readable text. The cool light of the screen touches his chin and cheeks. His response is familiar and neutral: his eyebrows stay relaxed and his mouth stays still, without disappointment. After a brief look, he presses the side button to lock the phone, the screen goes dark, and he slips the phone into the front pocket of his black trousers in one ordinary, fluid movement, then rests his hand on his knee. The camera holds a static shot for the whole duration. <Subject 1> (S1), in the same clean, natural, slightly low-pitched male voice, relaxed and reflective, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Not new people.</d> while his lips remain completely closed. Cool evening light from the windows falls softly across his face and shoulders. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet office ventilation continues. The phone lock button clicks softly, fabric rustles as the phone slides into his pocket, and the chair creaks once.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music: sustained synth pads at a slow tempo over a soft, steady low pulse, kept low in volume.
